title: 他买下Baremetrics，目标1000万ARR
title_jp: Baremetricsを買収、1000万ドルARRを目標に
author: 阿星
content:
{"ops": [{"insert": "他买下Baremetrics，目标1000万ARR"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "400万美元现金收购，现在要做到1000万ARR", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Luke Marshal在澳大利亚军队10年后，通过MBA和其他补充学习探索civilian career transition。得到Digital Transformation Manager角色，负责scoping和implementing modern systems进national organization anchored by legacy tech。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "几年后，former colleague介绍机会，在specialize small-scale B2B SaaS platforms的private equity firm工作。在DreamFactory做COO开始——instantly generates REST APIs帮助公司bridge legacy data stores和modern applications的gap。Introduced to SaaS sales、product development、SEO的wild world。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Role的第二部分包括continuing build Xenon Partners portfolio——through acquisitions of small-scale、B2B SaaS companies受益的disciplined、operationally focused leadership team。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大部分产品由passionate founders built，希望solve problem，但找不到next level growth。没有所有答案，但love能帮chaperone、see founder's vision for platform fruition的想法。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "过去六年，在几家SaaS companies间move——COO、CEO、Board Advisor，成为fund的General Partner。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2023年，机会出现，move back到hands-on CEO role within "}, {"insert": "Baremetrics", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "——2020年从Josh Pigford手中"}, {"insert": "$4M all cash deal", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "收购。Jumped at chance！"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在，努力成为subscription analytics的leader，让客户track和monitor every single dollar进business，discover every insight needed drive continued growth和success。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "收购以来，Baremetrics YOY reasonably steady growth。Prices八年没变，2022年初改了价，revenue spike，但long-tail churn eroded some gains。过去24个月，decreased churn by 50%，继续是focus。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Next revenue milestone：$10M ARR（约7000万人民币）。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "技术栈："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ruby on Rails + some React frontend", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "PostgreSQL、SingleStore、Redis多个database", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Private cloud network self-hosted", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "虽然不是founder，但continued build focus on market needs。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Initially，Baremetrics purely focused on Stripe，then branched out到Chargebee、Shopify Partners等其他providers。扩展多providers的挑战是reconcile如何ingest和process来自每个source的数据——plans vs product vs subscription存储和分类可能不同。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "给new starters的建议："}, {"insert": "build bulletproof tech stack。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " 随着多年build out产品、add new features和integrations，变得越来越hard be agile。Priority经常在getting new features out door as quickly as possible。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "可以到达single change in system A requires change in system B、C、D等的point。所以偶尔，worth reviewing how evergreen really are。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Stick to two big rocks", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Decrease white noise。Quarter goal setting时容易keep adding priorities，但很快发现if everything is priority，nothing is。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Stick to few core BAU goals focus on New MRR、Churn、Funnel——internal initiatives by sales、success、marketing。然后look up to two "big rocks"，需要更consolidated team effort——如new integration、UX changes、home page rebuild等。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "听起来像common sense，但和frustrated with progress的founders工作时，经常看到40-60% achievement of dozen goals in quarter without achieving 100% of one。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Revenue strategies", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Baremetrics有tiered pricing for core Metrics platform，随clients' MRR growth扩展。Incentivized help founders "make more"——他们grow，我们grow。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Expanded offerings over time include more value，包括powerful forecasting tools允许users build future financial scenarios beyond simple budgeting。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "除了Metrics，还有Recover dunning tool带ROI guarantee——如果没cover required amount of delinquencies和failed payments per month，essentially free。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Future revenue strategy：top-tier plans加更多value，lower-priced tiers扩展成freemium-style offering。认识到early-stage startups很难stomach big SaaS subscription bills，所以free tier（up to 30k MRR）有吸引力，然后incentivized help grow beyond free threshold。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "六、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Get ahead of AI search", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "像所有人一样，constantly trying find funnel能predictably、reliably scaled。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Longest time，Organic SEO king，regularly publishing quality content是build audience best way，所以有regular cadence of fresh、useful content drive funnel。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Over years，最大挑战是staying in front of Google search algorithm changes，确保multi-channel approach to marketing。现在more than ever，AI search implementation completely upended search rankings，ongoing challenge是getting in front of ICP。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "七、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Building brand awareness", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Strong brand history和association with Stripe，所以funnel predominantly organic SEO和referral。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Growing affiliate network，现在focus on how better rank for AI queries。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Attended several conferences over years——most recently SaaStr和Stripe Sessions。每次，great hear brand awareness在community中仍然possess。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Continue growth across social channels，increased focus on genuine、helpful interactions on Reddit，contributing to industry discussions on LinkedIn。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "八、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "建议："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Stick to basics，look satisfy very particular subset of total ICP before expanding too far。Conduct rapid experimental sprints find resonant message，then double down on winner。Backbone of all this是effective attribution——easier said than done，但nonetheless should be focus。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Biggest pitfall：pursuing ICP think should love product vs. pursuing ICP actually using product。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Above all else，"}, {"insert": "follow data and sell to build。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " Ask early users what want more of、how much willing pay。Each discovery call也用来gather intelligence on product gaps；not just pushing hard sell each time。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Develop constant feedback loop between customers和product development ensure continually increasing value和willingness to pay。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Luke的故事是private equity meets SaaS operations——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "$4M收购，现在目标是$10M ARR。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "核心insights——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Tech stack agility matters long-term", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Two big rocks per quarter（not 10 goals）", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Freemium can work if aligned incentives", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "AI search is disrupting SEO", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Follow data，not assumptions", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最重要的是，"}, {"insert": "he's not the founder，but respects the vision。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "That's how you grow an acquisition。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}]}
content_en: He bought Baremetrics target 10M ARR. 4 million cash acquisition now aiming for 10M ARR. Luke Marshal after 10 years in Australian army explored civilian career transition through MBA and supplementary learning. Got Digital Transformation Manager role scoping and implementing modern systems into national organization anchored by legacy tech. Years later former colleague introduced opportunity to work at private equity firm specializing small-scale B2B SaaS platforms. Started as COO at DreamFactory instantly generates REST APIs helping companies bridge legacy data stores and modern applications gap. Introduced to SaaS sales product development SEO wild world. Role involved evaluating potential acquisitions due diligence on companies considering selling.
content_jp: 彼はBaremetricsを購入、目标1000万ARR.400万ドルの現金での買収今1000万ARRを目指す. Luke Marshalオーストラリア軍で10年後、MBAと補完学習を通じて市民へのキャリア移行を探求. Digital Transformation Manager的角色、 レガシーテックを基盤としたnational organizationへのmodern systemsのscopeとimplementationを担当. 数年后、前同僚がsmall-scale B2B SaaS platformsを専門とするprivate equity firmへのを紹介. DreamFactoryでCOOとして開始—instantly generates REST APIs、レガシーdatastoresとmodern applicationsのgapを埋める companies help. SaaS sales、product development、SEOの世界にintroduced. ロールはsellを検討している会社のdue diligenceを含むpotential acquisitionsの評価涉及.
content_ar: اشترى Baremetrics هدف 10M ARR. 4 ملايين نقداً الآن تستهدف 10M ARR. Luke Marshal بعد 10 سنوات في الجيش الأسترالي استكشف التحول الوظيفي المدني من خلال MBA والتعلم التكميلي. حصل على دور مدير التحول الرقمي scoping وتنفيذ الأنظمة الحديثة في مؤسسة وطنية تعتمد على التكنولوجيا القديمة. بعد سنوات قدم زميل سابق فرصة للعمل في شركة ملكية خاصة متخصصة في منصات SaaS B2B صغيرة الحجم. بدأ كرئيس العمليات في DreamFactory يولد فوراً REST APIs يساعد الشركات في سد الفجوة بين متاجر البيانات القديمة والتطبيقات الحديثة. تعرف على مبيعات SaaS وتطوير المنتج وعالم SEO البريء. الدور تضمن تقييم عمليات الاستحواذ المحتملة العناية الواجبة بالشركات التي تفكر في البيع.
